title: O'Blood, Dirt and Cum
tagline: SkyrimNet knows when someone is dirty, bloody, cum-covered or bathing in Dirt and Blood, and a bath washes OCum's cum off too.
description: Standalone SkyrimNet companion for Dirt and Blood - Dynamic Visuals (a companion, not a replacement). A character_bio prompt states plain facts about dirt, blood and (with OCum) cum, and the WashUp action lets a follower wash with Dirt and Blood's own bath, following its soap and water rules. The plugin OBlood_Dirt_and_Cum.esp adds state events, bath memories, public mod events and, with OCum installed, washes OCum's cum off during any real Dirt and Blood bath. By That Guy (Coronerra).
